limitations_and_boundaries: In certain test scenarios, the available datasets are currently insufficient, which may lead to bias.
The proposed cellular context embedding strategy is currently applicable only to cell-line-derived contexts, not patient-derived contexts.
The cellular context embedding strategy shows only limited improvements (mainly in PCC-delta and Common-DEGs) and does not consistently surpass baseline methods across all metrics.
Current work does not address poor performance on population-distribution metrics.
Robustness evaluation focuses on technical artifacts (noise, sparsity) rather than biological variability.

research_questions.statement: How do computational methods for single-cell perturbation response prediction compare in terms of generalizability across cellular contexts and unseen perturbations?
